title: Filtering: The WHERE Clause
short_description: Learn to filter rows using logical conditions.
detailed_description: In this quest, you will learn how to use the `WHERE` clause to filter data from a table. You'll apply multiple conditions (AND/OR) and handle basic data types.

objectives.title: Use WHERE clause
objectives.text: Filter results using a WHERE clause
objectives.why: The WHERE clause is used to filter records that fulfill a specified condition.

objectives.title: Correct Filters
objectives.text: Filter by is_active=1, city='Detroit', and age >= 25
objectives.why: We need precisely matched active users in the Detroit region.

objectives.title: Return Correct Columns
objectives.why: The spec requires precisely these three columns.

objectives.title: Query executes successfully
objectives.why: The database must be able to parse and run your query.
